name: ubi-construction-suite
description: Construction management suite for Ulticon Builders, Inc. and Omega Asia — everything outside the Acumatica ERP.

scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ubi/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ubi/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ubi/api && npm run build -w @ubi/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w @ubi/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @ubi/api -w @ubi/web
